result:
The proposed construction is invalid, so the justification for 1349 fails.

The three-center construction violates the regulation. Take a leaf L attached to central vertices A and B. At A, the edge AL must match AB = X or else LB must exist with the third color, and since LB exists, that case is fine only if AL has the color that makes the triangle valid. In fact, checking every attachment type shows that a leaf attached to two central vertices must use exactly one color pattern (for the AB pair, LA = Y and LB = Z). Two different leaf types on different pairs, or on the same pair, create a clash at a shared central vertex that has no closing edge. So the six-group partition cannot exist. Only one leaf type can be used, which gives counts (1, 2023, 2023), not (1349, 1349, 1349).

A valid construction does exist with max 2023: take cities A and B with AB = X, and join each of the other 2023 cities to A with Y and to B with Z. Check: at A, the Y-neighbors and B are joined by Z edges (the required third color), and at each other city, AB = X is the third color of its two edges. The total is 4047 edges with n_X = 1, n_Y = n_Z = 2023. Its max, 2023, is below the monochromatic-tree value 2024.

I also checked several other families (K4 blow-ups, tripartite blow-ups, the wheel W4 and its blow-ups). Each gives max ≥ n − 2 = 2023. A degree-2 vertex forces the graph to be of this K_{1,1,m} form. I have not proven that 2023 is the global minimum, but the evidence points there. Either way, 1349 is not justified by the given construction, and I have not found any balanced valid structure reaching it.

VERDICT: REJECT
CONFIDENCE: 4
